holstentor.name: Holstentor
holstentor.slogan: Two fat brick towers, sinking gracefully since 1478.
holstentor.line: Its field-side inscription reads Concordia domi foris pax: harmony within, peace outside.

marienkirche.name: St. Mary's Church
marienkirche.slogan: The bells still lie where they fell on the Palm Sunday night of 1942.
marienkirche.line: Its nave holds the world's tallest brick vault, 38.5 metres high; rebuilt between 1947 and 1959.

niederegger.name: Café Niederegger
niederegger.slogan: Marzipan, served across from the Rathaus steps since 1822.
niederegger.line: Johann Georg Niederegger, a pastry chef from Ulm, took over a Lübeck confectioner's shop on 1 March 1806.

passat.name: Passat
passat.slogan: A Cape Horn windjammer, moored for good at Travemünde.
passat.line: Built in Hamburg in 1911, the four-masted barque rounded Cape Horn 39 times.

fehmarnsundbridge.name: Fehmarnsund Bridge
fehmarnsundbridge.slogan: The Coat Hanger: one steel arch between the mainland and Fehmarn.
fehmarnsundbridge.line: Opened on 30 April 1963, its arch rises 45 metres above the roadway and carries both road and rail.
